title Gimnasio Fuego - the fire gym: the gym's growing pulse, but it gallops (kick, then two quick notes) in A phrygian, flames that flicker on a half step, a hot lick, a chromatic climb up two octaves and a roll of crackles (150 bpm)
tempo 150
vol 230
meter 4/4
inst p1 v=120,80,60
inst p2 v=170,120,90
inst p3 v=220,160,120
inst p4 v=255,200,150
inst lead v=255,255,225,195,180
inst flick arp=0,1 rate=1 lvl=0.9
inst kick drum=g5 v=255,200,140 d=0,-45,-75
inst crk drum=e7 noise=60 seed=5 fall=6
l16
# --- 1-2: the gallop alone, then with the kick
@p1 o3 [ a8 a a ]4 |
@p2 o3 [ !kick:a8 a a ]4 |
# --- 3-4: it leans on the B flat (phrygian)
@p3 o3 [ !kick:a8 a a ]3 !kick:a8 a b- |
@p3 o3 [ !kick:a8 b- b- ]4 |
# --- 5-6: the hot lick
@lead o5 a8 b-8 >c+4< b-8 a8 g4 |
@lead o5 f8 g8 a4 g8 f8 e4 |
# --- 7: the flames flicker
@flick o5 a1 |
# --- 8: the climb, chromatic, up two octaves
@p4 o3 a b- b >c c+ d d+ e f f+ g g+ a a+ b >c<< |
# --- 9: the roll of crackles
[ !crk16 ]16 |
